Work Sites: Bull Run

By mrogers August 30, 2025

Bull Run

From the highs of Norris to the lows of Bull Run. The once site that was in the process of being demolished. I wish I could have seen this site in its glory. When I first started working for TVA Bull Run was a live plant. I helped with computers at the site. Bull Run words were spoken daily. And then not. And now it’s been completely shut down.

However there is hope for the future of Bull Run! A possible first site of the new modular Fusion plants. I sure hope Bull Run rolls off our tongues again soon. <o:p></o:p>
